title: Weather widget temperature overlay obscures a lot of the current weather icon, especially at small icon size/panel thickness
line: With “Show temperature: Over the widget icon”, the weather icon in the panel is no longer hidden by the temperature badge.
explanation: In “Over the widget icon” mode the weather applet put a Kirigami badge on the icon's bottom-right corner. The badge's size comes from the font, not from the icon, so it is about as tall as half a panel icon and wider than it with the unit (“60°F”): it hid the lower half to two thirds of the icon at normal panel sizes and almost all of it in thin panels. Now the icon is shrunk to leave room for the badge below it, the badge shows only the degrees (“60°”, the full value with unit is still in the tooltip), vertical panels give the widget extra height for the badge, and in horizontal panels too thin to fit an icon plus the badge the temperature is shown beside the icon as in the “Beside” mode. When the plasmoid is forced square (system tray) the old overlay is kept.

commits.message:
applets/weather: don't cover the icon with the temperature badge

The badge sat on top of the icon and hid most of it, being about as big
as a panel icon. It now goes below a smaller icon and drops the unit,
and thin horizontal panels show the temperature beside the icon instead.

BUG: 497471

patches.diff:
From 21ecd4369a9b4282c4bbc3a8ed3c64e4e7e7abfc Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 18:16:29 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/weather: don't cover the icon with the temperature
 badge

The badge sat on top of the icon and hid most of it, being about as big
as a panel icon. It now goes below a smaller icon and drops the unit,
and thin horizontal panels show the temperature beside the icon instead.

BUG: 497471
---
 applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml | 48 ++++++++++---------
 1 file changed, 26 insertions(+), 22 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
index c66ae91a7..9d2d02f1c 100644
--- a/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/weather/qml/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -29,7 +29,9 @@ Loader {
 
     readonly property bool needsToBeSquare: (Plasmoid.containmentType & PlasmaCore.Types.CustomEmbeddedContainment)
         || (Plasmoid.containmentDisplayHints & PlasmaCore.Types.ContainmentForcesSquarePlasmoids)
-    readonly property bool useBadge: Plasmoid.configuration.showTemperatureInBadge || needsToBeSquare
+    // In a thin horizontal panel there is no room for the badge below the icon, so show the temperature beside it
+    readonly property bool useBadge: needsToBeSquare
+        || (Plasmoid.configuration.showTemperatureInBadge && (vertical || height >= Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small + badgeMetrics.implicitHeight))
 
     signal toggleExpandedRequested
     
@@ -39,6 +41,12 @@ Loader {
     Layout.minimumWidth: (item as Item).Layout.minimumWidth
     Layout.minimumHeight: (item as Item).Layout.minimumHeight
 
+    WorkspaceComponents.BadgeOverlay {
+        id: badgeMetrics
+        visible: false
+        text: "0"
+    }
+
     MouseArea {
         id: compactMouseArea
         anchors.fill: parent
@@ -51,41 +59,37 @@ Loader {
     Component {
         id: iconComponent
 
-        Kirigami.Icon {
-            id: weatherIcon
+        Item {
+            id: iconItem
             readonly property int minIconSize: Math.max((compactRoot.vertical ? compactRoot.width : compactRoot.height), Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small)
 
-            source: Plasmoid.icon
-            fallback: Util.unknownWeatherIcon
-            active: compactMouseArea.containsMouse
             // reset implicit size, so layout in free dimension does not stop at the default one
             implicitWidth: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small
             implicitHeight: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small
             Layout.minimumWidth: compactRoot.vertical ? Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small : minIconSize
-            Layout.minimumHeight: compactRoot.vertical ? minIconSize : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small
+            Layout.minimumHeight: compactRoot.vertical ? minIconSize + weatherIcon.anchors.bottomMargin : Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.small
+
+            Kirigami.Icon {
+                id: weatherIcon
+
+                // Leave room for the badge below the icon instead of covering it
+                anchors.fill: parent
+                anchors.bottomMargin: badge.visible && !compactRoot.needsToBeSquare ? badge.height : 0
+
+                source: Plasmoid.icon
+                fallback: Util.unknownWeatherIcon
+                active: compactMouseArea.containsMouse
+            }
 
             WorkspaceComponents.BadgeOverlay {
                 id: badge
 
-                anchors.right: parent.right
+                anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
                 anchors.bottom: parent.bottom
 
                 visible: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent && compactRoot.showTemperature && compactRoot.useBadge && text.length > 0
 
-                text: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(compactRoot.displayTemperatureUnit, compactRoot.lastObservation.temperature, compactRoot.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, false) : "";
-                icon: parent
-
-                // Non-default state to center if the badge is wider than the icon
-                states: [
-                    State {
-                        when: badge.width >= weatherIcon.width
-                        AnchorChanges {
-                            target: badge
-                            anchors.right: undefined
-                            anchors.horizontalCenter: parent.horizontalCenter
-                        }
-                    }
-                ]
+                text: compactRoot.isTemperaturePresent ? Util.temperatureToDisplayString(compactRoot.displayTemperatureUnit, compactRoot.lastObservation.temperature, compactRoot.metaData.temperatureUnit, true, true) : "";
             }
         }
     }
--

28 px panel with the fix: too thin for both, so the temperature is shown beside the icon
